description: This Mendeley release contains ten thousand Sentinel-2 RGB image chips for binary railway-presence classification across metropolitan France. Half are labelled with rail and half without. Each PNG is 224 by 224 pixels and covers a 512-metre square; locations were selected using OpenStreetMap railway geometries, distance thinning and geographic balancing. The public version 1 lists an image ZIP and images.csv under CC BY 4.0. It is an image benchmark for detecting railway presence, not a verified, connected rail network graph or an asset-condition survey. OpenStreetMap label quality, satellite pixel size and local negative-sample selection are limitations for finding small or concealed rail assets. A reviewer-assessed use is testing railway-exposure mapping that could feed later rail-network simulations. data-openstreetmap is a related input source explicitly used by the producer, but no chip coordinates were matched here. Neither archive nor image files were downloaded.
